## Episode Thesis

This episode reviews the DI/Expressen party leader debate ahead of the Swedish election. It covers ISK taxation, the proposed bank tax, the karensavdrag (sick-pay waiting day) and which parties might form a government. The guests, entrepreneur Gunilla von Platen and DI editorial writer Tobias Wikström, criticise the left bloc's proposals. They argue that a bank tax would probably be passed on to mortgage borrowers, and SBAB comes up as a low-rate alternative. No listed company gets a directional investment view.
